source_material_limit: The three Tripo building prefabs currently bind one authored color atlas each, without independent real normal/roughness maps. Color atlases contain baked-looking shading and some soft details. Additional triangles alone cannot recover missing texture detail.
wall_observation: Original source-wall.png already shows uneven crenellations/edges. Verified source-preserving assembly does not imply a straight or visually approved kit; repeated modules amplify the original irregularity.
recommended_next_step: Compare one source building and a small fixed-view environment slice before increasing all model/texture budgets; measure visible units, skinning, draw submission, shadows, overdraw and AI separately.
